game_name: Vampire Savior 2: The Lord of Vampire (Japan 970913 Phoenix Edition) (bootleg)
general_issues: Select vsav2d.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Test Menu waits for the Phoenix startup screen to finish before pressing the original game Test switch; allow about 60 emulated seconds. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. Press Test to release the startup Test switch when navigating a boot-time operator screen. TPO automatically assigns up to 2 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Rollback uses a canonical two-frame input delay; every linked cabinet and serial queue is restored together. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
